cards.text: A leaf brows, B a nose with a leaf, C hollows.

cards.title: Elder Ent: three faces
cards.text: A a scowl with peg teeth, B a nose and moss moustache, C lantern eyes. It is also bigger in the game now.
cards.why: You wrote: "Change face. 3 versions. They should also be very big" Comment with the letter to keep, or what to change. The game keeps its current art until you pick.

cards.title: Sproutling: three takes
cards.text: A turnip, B acorn, C bud.
cards.why: You wrote: "Don't like." Comment with the letter to keep, or what to change. The game keeps its current art until you pick.

cards.title: Golem: three bodies
cards.text: A boulders, B blocks, C a hunch. The eye is kept as it was.
cards.why: You wrote: "First get down basic golems body. Make 3 variants." Comment with the letter to keep, or what to change. The game keeps its current art until you pick.

cards.title: Gilded golem: the three
cards.text: Each of the three bodies in gold.
cards.why: You wrote: "Then make gilded. Note I love the eye." Comment with the letter to keep, or what to change. The game keeps its current art until you pick.

cards.title: Frost spirit's tail
cards.text: The core alone, and a mock-up of the wiggling tail the game will draw behind it.
cards.why: You wrote: "That tail should be like that rat tail where it's wiggly/ follows behind" Comment with the letter to keep, or what to change. The game keeps its current art until you pick.

cards.title: A biblically accurate ange
cards.text: One great eye, two crossing wheels set with eyes, six wings: for the Spire's boss, which is being rebuilt.
cards.why: You wrote: "I want one of those biblically accurate angels." Comment with the letter to keep, or what to change. The game keeps its current art until you pick.
